news.text: Lucio Redesigns #JuveThe strategy for JanuaryHunt for a mezzala and a center-forward: #Spalletti is pushing for ready-made players in the style of #Sørloth.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#CALHANOGLU TEMPTS #JUVEThe Turk's contract is expiring, renewal with #Inter is difficult.In addition to the return to his homeland and Saudi offers, the nerazzurro ace is also evaluating #Como: however, #Massara knows him from their time at #Milan... Among the free agents, #Raum from #Leipzig is rising. Nico #González is back against #Venezia.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🧐⁉️ With the return of #Conceição and Nico #González, #Spalletti will have new alternatives on the attacking flanks. #KoloMuani's position in particular needs to be evaluated, having recently been deployed specifically as a right winger. With the recovery of the Portuguese, the coach could alternate the two on that flank, choosing based on the opponent and the needs of the match.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

✅‼️#Juventus has already had contacts for #Varela, just like #Napoli, and will soon discuss it again. A situation to follow for the January mercato, to monitor whether or not the bianconeri will make a decisive push for the Portuguese striker.[Mirko Di Natale]
❌ #Juventus will not evaluate offers in January for Adin #Licina.[Mirko Di Natale]

🇮🇹👀 #Juventus, #Udogie emerges to reinforce the left flank: he could become a concrete alternative to #AïtNouri and #Balde, currently among the main candidates. #Tottenham would be looking for a temporary solution for the Italian and the relations with the bianconero club are excellent. The track remains one to monitor ahead of January.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹❓"#Cambiaso is no longer untouchable or unsellable. He has also lost his starting spot and, if an adequate offer were to arrive, considering his contract is not expiring, as he still has about three years and a half left on it, the situation could be seriously discussed."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 Hakan #Calhanoglu, #Inter midfielder with a contract until June 30, 2027, has once again been linked with #Juventus.Between January and February 2026, the bianconero management made some exploratory calls to inquire about his contractual situation.At that time, #Juve was still led on the management side by Damien #Comolli.NO OFFERS▪️ #Juventus never submitted official offers, neither to #Inter nor to the player: it was merely a preliminary inquiry.▫️ Afterward, #Calhanoglu chose to stay at #Inter; in the summer interest from #Fenerbahçe also emerged, which did not materialize.▪️ Today, #Juve has changed its management and answers to Giovanni #Carnevali, so any new developments would have t

🔛⚡️ "For the left-back role, in addition to the already known names (#Tagliafico, #Miranda, #AïtNouri and others), #Juventus is continuing its scouting work, also taking advantage of the international break during these weeks, with the aim of identifying any alternative profiles and new mercato opportunities."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇹🇷🆙 #Yildiz has begun the athletic reconditioning phase and aims to return on mid-December. He has completed a large part of his rehabilitation program, recording positive progress. The dates circled in red for his return are December 14 against #Monza or December 19 against #Roma. #Juventus, however, is maintaining maximum caution to avoid relapses.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🆙⚡️ #Juventus wants a left-back as soon as possible, without necessarily waiting for potential departures. In addition to #Miranda, the list includes #Raum and #Mitchell, whose contracts expire in 2027 and could potentially be signed on a free transfer, though the club is evaluating the possibility of bringing the investment forward to January, if their respective clubs accept a modest compensation fee. If the asking prices are high, the move could be postponed until the summer, focusing instead on loan deals with an option to buy.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹🤨 The permanent buyout of #DiGregorio from #Bournemouth appears complicated. His return to Turin therefore seems likely, along with the need to find a new destination. However, staying at #Juventus as the second-choice goalkeeper is not ruled out. In fact, it is difficult to find a club willing to invest around €9M, his current book value.[Andrea Losapio - TuttoJuve via @juventusinsidernews]

🧐❗️Turin-Madrid axis heats up: #David has further reduced #Sørloth's playing time and #Juventus is once again a concrete option, also because #Spalletti wants a physical striker. #AtléticoMadrid values him at €30M, while #Carnevali aims to sell the Canadian for €25M. The Norwegian has already asked to find solutions in January. The most viable path is a loan, postponing the possible swap between the two until the end of the season.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🚑 Kenan #Yildiz, from #Juventus, completed a gym session at the bianconero sports center to speed up his recovery.He has the home match against #Monza on December 14 circled in red, though it is not ruled out that he could be available again as early as the week prior.Several of the injured players also chose to work during the break to accelerate their recovery timelines.#CONCEIÇAO▪️ Francisco #Conceição, now recovered from his shoulder issue, gave up the four days off that #Spalletti granted the squad.▫️ He showed up at la Continassa to train individually and try to win back the manager.[@tuttosport via @junews24com - @PuebloJ]

🔙✅ Great news at #Juventus: following Francisco #Conceição's return to the group, Luciano #Spalletti also welcomes back Nico #González. The two bianconeri wingers will therefore be available for selection for the match against #Venezia schedule for Sunday November 22 at 12:30 PM.[Di Marzio via @juventusinsidernews]

📊 Gleison #Bremer is the #Juventus top goalscorer in Serie A, with 3 goals.Only #KoloMuani and #Woltemade surpass him if Europa League goals are added: they have 4 each.HIS NUMBERS▪️ He is the highest-scoring central defender in Europe since 2019.▫️ Since his first goal in a #Torino shirt, no other player in his position has scored 25 goals across Europe's top five goals.▪️ This season, he shares the top spot among goalscoring center-backs with #Upamecano (#Bayern), #Marquinhos (#PSG) and #Bartra (#Betis).▫️ He missed matches due to the knee surgery that kept him off the pitch for around a year.[@Marcamat0 on @tuttosport via @PuebloJ]

👀 #Juventus has frozen all contract renewals at least until March, due to strong technical uncertainties and questions on the future of the bench.THE LATEST RENEWALS▪️ #Yildiz: from €1.5M up €6.5M▫️ #Locatelli: from €3M to €4M▪️ #McKennie: from €2.5M to €4.5M▫️ Nico #González was also renewedThese deals added €16M per year to the balance sheetTHE SUMMERFew resources will be freed up with the departures of #Neto, #Milik, #Grabara, #Sarr and #Woltemade.#Woltemade's €5.5M salary will have to be reinvested in a replacement of a similar cost.THE EXCEPTION ▪️ #Kalulu currently earns €2.5M and aims to reach €4M.▫️ The club is evaluating a middle ground to improve his salary.▪️ He started in the fir

👀 #Juventus has entered the race for Gustavo #Varela, Portuguese striker from #Monza, in a duel with #Napoli and the sporting director Manna.Recently called up to the senior Portugal National Team, he is on the shortlist of #Carnevali, #Massara and #Ottolini.Many clubs have already inquired about him, from #Arsenal to #Tottenham, passing by #Barcelona.#Napoli has a very good relationship with #Monza and also with the player's agents.THE TIMELINE▪️ It is difficult to imagine a deal in January: #Juric's #Monza needs him to avoid relegation and the idea is to sell him in summer.▫️ If he confirms the impact he has had so far in the Italian league, the asking price could be around €30-35M.THE ENT
